title: APP-CARE: App-based Programs for Providing Caregiver Assistance, Resources, and Education
official: Comparing Two Remote Support Technologies for Caregivers to Address Behaviors of People Living With Dementia
summary:
This study will compare the effectiveness of two web-based dementia caregiver support programs, Plans4Care and Trualta, delivered through Area Agencies on Aging across the United States.

Thirty Area Agencies on Aging will be randomized to deliver either Plans4Care or Trualta to family caregivers of persons living with Alzheimer's disease or related dementias. The study plans to enroll at least 626 caregivers, with approximately 500 expected to complete follow-up assessments.

Participants will use their assigned support program over 12 months and complete surveys at baseline, 3 months, and 12 months. The study will compare changes in dementia-related behavioral symptoms and caregiver well-being, including depressive symptoms, mastery, relationship strain, health strain, and social isolation. It will also assess the feasibility, acceptability, and appropriateness of implementing the two programs in community-based aging services.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Family caregiver of a person diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease or a related dementia.
* Caregiver resides in the catchment area of a participating Area Agency on Aging.
* Caregiver is the person most responsible for caring for an individual diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease or a related dementia.
* Caregiver speaks English or Spanish.
* Caregiver is willing to complete baseline, 3-month, and 12-month surveys, with the possibility of a post-trial semi-structured interview.
* Caregiver is 21 years of age or older.

Exclusion Criteria:

* The caregiver or care recipient has been hospitalized three or more times during the previous year.
* The caregiver or care recipient is currently receiving treatment for a life-threatening condition.
* The caregiver is currently enrolled in another evidence-based dementia caregiver intervention identified in the Best Programs for Caregiving database.
